name: PrimalMyst Damage Taxonomy
description: Defines the three mechanical damage delivery modes used across combat systems.

overwhelm.label: Overwhelm
overwhelm.summary: Large-impact events such as slams, shockwaves, or wide-area spells.

dot.label: Damage over Time
dot.summary: Effects that apply smaller pulses across multiple ticks.

universal_rules.resource_floor: Every individual damage instance consumes 1 HP, 1 MP, and 1 SP before mitigation, ensuring a non-zero cost when damage connects.
universal_rules.stacking_note: Multiple types can coexist in a single ability but are resolved separately.
